rule: PRIVACY RULE. No section or polling place is named, located or listed. The smallest unit is the municipality (a city, for votes abroad).
A municipality or city is named only if it has at least 50 apt voters and neither candidate has 0 votes or all the valid votes in it. Others are pooled per state as 'other, pooled'.

No municipal-level file counts zero or near-unanimous sections. Zero sections are published only nationally, by region and by state, and as national place-category totals by two methods (official registers within 1 km, and the text rule), with cells under 10 sections suppressed.
Source: TSE open data, 2026 round 2, President. See SOURCES.md. Built by 08_interactive.py (v2).

events.share_lt_1pct: candidate had under 1% of valid votes

meta.min_valid_votes: sections included have at least this many valid votes
meta.upper_99_9_exact: exact 99.9% quantile of the Poisson-binomial sum, sections independent
meta.upper_99_9_normal: v1 normal approximation, kept for comparison
meta.model_status: pre-registered, fixed in v2, or added after results
meta.caution: A matching total does not mean a model finds the zero sections. See FINDINGS-v2.md, M1.
